reason:
Static tokenizer audit after the initial preregistration found that the literal prompt suffix '
Answer:' is not representable in the common <4096 token space under the frozen production tokenizer: the committed encoding audit maps the token 'Answer' in an answer-format probe to ID 18224. Because the eligibility filter requires every content token ID <4096, the original delimiter would make the intended shared-token surface impossible or severely degenerate before any model outcome exists.

change.rationale: Use only a newline boundary, which is directly observed as low ID 202 in multiple committed tokenizer probes. Answer content remains eligibility-filtered by the same <4096 rule. Removing the leading-space prefix avoids introducing an unnecessary context-dependent merged token before the answer.
